turns:
Fix the discount bug in shop/discount.py: apply_discount(price, pct) must return the price AFTER applying a pct-percent discount, not the discount amount itself.
Scope: shop/discount.py only
Acceptance criteria: apply_discount(100, 20) == 80.0 and every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
Stop when the tests pass.
